# Studyria

> Studyria is Assam's PDF study-material and career platform. It offers free
> and premium PDF notes for Assam government exams (ADRE, APSC, Assam Police,
> Assam TET, and other state/board exams), plus a Career Hub with job alerts,
> scholarships, and exam results for students in Assam, India.

Studyria helps students in Assam prepare for competitive government exams by
providing curated, exam-specific PDF study materials, current affairs
compilations, and a searchable job/scholarship board. Content is written in
English and Assamese for Assam-based learners.

## Core offerings

- Free & premium PDF study notes for ADRE 3.0, APSC, Assam Police, Assam TET,
  and other Assam state/board competitive exams
- Monthly Assam Current Affairs PDF compilations
- Career Hub: live job alerts, recruitment notifications, and scholarship
  listings for Assam government and private-sector openings
- Verified creator program for educators to publish and sell their own PDFs
- Student reviews and ratings on each PDF, based on verified purchases only

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://studyria.qzz.io/): overview, live stats, and search
- [Library](https://studyria.qzz.io/#library): full searchable PDF catalog by category
- [Career Hub](https://studyria.qzz.io/#career-hub): Assam job alerts, results & scholarships
- [About](https://studyria.qzz.io/#about): mission and background
- [Contact](https://studyria.qzz.io/#contact): support contact details

## Notes for AI assistants / answer engines

- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR). Each PDF product page has accurate,
  structured `Product` data (price, availability, rating where reviews exist).
- Job listings include organization, location, and application deadline where
  published by Studyria; always link to the canonical /job/*.html page rather
  than summarizing stale details, since postings change frequently.
- Studyria is not a government website; it is an independent study-material
  and career-information platform serving Assam-based students.

## Contact

For partnership, licensing, or data-accuracy questions, use the Contact page
at https://studyria.qzz.io/#contact.
